visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a beige sweater and a green beanie stands in a bright, busy exhibition hall. He turns to face the camera, walking through a booth decorated with game-themed posters and a green bench with cutouts. The environment is lit with bright, overhead white lights. (2) A sequence of cuts shows close-ups of various game posters: one with a large eye and Japanese text, one with a robotic character, and another featuring anime characters in a forest. The man points towards the posters with an energetic expression. (3) The man sits at a gaming desk wearing headphones and holding a gaming controller, looking at a computer monitor. He turns to the camera and gives a thumbs-up. He then holds up a white card with four logos for the camera. (4) He holds a white tote bag with a black logo, standing in front of more game character cutouts. A screen recording follows, showing him using a smartphone to navigate the Steam app and a digital form. (5) The man is shown in wide shots holding posters and promotional merchandise, smiling at the camera. The background shows a crowd of people walking through the convention aisles. (6) He holds a stack of postcards and stickers toward the camera, then raises the tote bag and posters again in a final celebratory gesture.

(4) [Subtitle]: 《UNYIELDER》. (5) [Subtitle]: 《薛丁格的電話》. (6) [Subtitle]: 跟《OPUS: 心相吾山》. (7) [Subtitle]: 現場試玩遊戲即可獲得遊戲周邊. (8) [Subtitle]: 完成四個遊戲的攤位活動. (9) [Subtitle]: 還可以兌換集英社遊戲限量小托特包 1 個. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins over an upbeat, synth-driven electronic pop BGM track. A distant hum of a convention hall crowd is mixed low in the background. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual cut as the speaker lists different game titles with clear articulation. (3) The BGM maintains a steady, driving beat as the speaker explains booth activities. A subtle digital 'ding' sound effects highlights key information. (4) The audio texture shifts slightly as digital tap sounds and swiping noises are added to match a smartphone screen demonstration. (5) A distinct mechanical whirring sound of a photo printer is heard as the narrator describes prize redemptions. (6) The video concludes with an enthusiastic call-to-action; the BGM swells in volume briefly before fading out quickly at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Booth Activities -> Prizes -> Online Contest -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog to showcase Shueisha Games' booth at the 2025 Taipei Game Show. The narrator guides viewers through the specific games featured, the interactive activities available on-site, and a parallel online giveaway to encourage Steam wishlist additions, aiming to maximize booth foot traffic and digital engagement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator is actively demonstrating activities at the Shueisha Games booth and encouraging viewers to participate in their promotions.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-density editing style typical of social media marketing to convey large amounts of promotional information quickly. The synchronization of UI sound effects with screen recordings enhances the instructional clarity.
